voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: The Atlantic, eighteen seventy-two. The Mary Celeste was found drifting, empty, with seventeen hundred and one barrels of alcohol aboard.
When she was unloaded, nine of those barrels were empty.
The rest were white oak. Those nine were red oak, a more porous wood.
One theory: vapour from the leaks filled the hold, and a sudden flash frightened everyone into the only boat.
In two thousand six, a chemist tested the idea in a model hold. A wave of flame swept through. Nothing was scorched. A possible answer, not a proven one.
